numericAndStateLaws: UTF-16 classification truncates the input to sixteen bits. Private character classification uses fixed arithmetic ranges and requires no registry or RAM globals.
A32 address, width and coordinate operations wrap modulo 2^32. Composed and glyph counters wrap modulo 2^16.
Count packing adds groups*256 modulo 65536 only when groups exceeds one. Unpacking treats 0x100 as a single-group count of 256; 0x101 becomes count one, group one.
Script-run scanning stops at absolute character offset fifty, not fifty characters after the supplied start. Neutral lookahead may scan beyond this cap.
Neutral leading text selects the supplied base direction's default mode. Bracket nesting affects the opposite-direction neutral boundary.
Row selection publishes cursor mutations from each comparison, including unsuccessful script and language comparisons.
Arabic pair composition consumes the following UTF-16 unit for the specified hamza and maddah pairs, then uses the original joining-category and state-transition tables.
Arabic dictionary version other than one disables substitutions and returns warning four after normalization and measurement. Short workspace returns zero before those effects.
Arabic ligature candidates execute real glyph-advance lookup. Contextual restart retains the accepted source length and searches the alternate joining state.
Thai sara-am expansion emits nikhahit followed by sara-aa and retains the original two-glyph packed mapping.
Thai measurement suppresses the advances of table-approved combining glyphs. Positioning retains each glyph's real advance and separately computes its mark origin.
Thai lower-mark clipping calls real stroke-padding, height, glyph-advance and right-overhang implementations in that order.
Thai raster clipping initializes all seventeen words. At 11898e0/11898e8 the five-word descriptor copy places top into word nine of the passed structure; the draft C omitted this copy.
Reachable Hebrew normalization replaces each mark in 0591..05c7 with dotted circle 25cc, excluding 05be, 05c0 and 05c6. It does not invoke the separate presentation-form composer.
Reverse positioning publishes reversed glyph codes while preserving original character associations. Hebrew marks do not advance the final pen.
Shape phase two skips measurement. Other phases measure, and render only when bit one is set.
Rendering uses the original inclusive glyph bounds. Even a zero-character span can select one stale glyph when both stored glyph bounds are zero.
Outline errors stop the glyph loop after publishing the updated buffer pointer. Bitmap draw return values are ignored by the script rows.

sharedOwnership.DevelopTransactionOwnership.PipelineTran: font_fdl::FontEngine supplies real fast metric, glyph-advance, Thai metric, stroke-padding, clipped outline append and clipped bitmap draw implementations. No arbitrary callback thunk is retained here.
sharedOwnership.DevelopTransactionOwnership.PipelineMoti: Owns the real raster loader/VM/flush path. The shared rectangle fixture is FontFdlScenarios.fontRectangleRasterInitial.
sharedOwnership.FontBuiltinBackends: Owns the real BDF text parser, glyph metrics and packed bitmap renderer used by active script cases.
sharedOwnership.FontOutlineVm: Owns the outline VM reached through the shared frontend, not any script-row implementation.

modelIntegration.runtime: Original cases must also receive the authenticated executable numeric runtime supplied by ImagePixelsScenarios.arithmeticInitial kernel0 image4. No arithmetic event echoes are supplied.
modelIntegration.callbackBinding: BDF and raster callback slots bind original entries to their semantic owned publications. Script methods call those real owned implementations.
modelIntegration.textFixtures: Valid authored BDF headers, per-codepoint glyph records, Unicode directory pages and literal A8/50/F8 bitmap rows run through the actual owned parser and renderer. These are explicitly authored fixtures, not claimed vendor font fragments or mocked metric callbacks.
modelIntegration.textExpectations: Packed bitmap expectations are independent geometric ink sets over nonzero sentinel buffers. They cover Basic, Arabic, Thai, Hebrew and Thai clipping.
modelIntegration.rectangleFixture: The valid authored FDL RectangleA fixture executes the real loader, raster VM and flush. Its analytic full-rectangle expectation is 1024 bytes of coverage fifteen. It is not relabeled as the stock IconE14d glyph.
